headline: Unbeaten Leeds cruise past Newcastle 4-1 in Premier League clash
description: Leeds sent sorry Newcastle spinning to a 4-1 defeat at Elland Road to extend their unbeaten Premier League start and climb to third in the table.

headline: VAR from Manchester derby not given a Premier League game for upcoming weekend
description: The VAR who made an "error of judgement" in awarding a goal to Manchester City in Sunday's derby at Old Trafford has not been appointed to a Premier League game this weekend.

headline: Roberto De Zerbi leaves Richarlison out of Spurs' Carabao Cup squad for Liverpool clash
description: Roberto De Zerbi has turned down the chance to include Richarlison in Tottenham's squad for Tuesday's Carabao Cup tie at Liverpool.
